propositions: Plan-material-pin health (drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) without adding noise to list output or persisted events.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets, normalized roles, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and required/signed phases without independently recreating status strings.
Pin enforcement-disabled drift must be labeled as advisory and visibly distinguished from legacy-unpinned state, while ordinary list output and stored ticket events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page-assembly boundary after audit_trail produces stored data, catching missing attestation, timeouts, or exceptions and rendering derived-health unavailable without changing audit_trail behavior or silently altering close-error allow/deny semantics.

Advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, enforcement toggles, and close-versus-claim freshness; basic user docs must not include this content.

Output schemas must be additive with rollback compatibility; golden tests and audit/rendering/MCP/CLI tests must verify canonical health semantics and fixture coverage (current, drifted, disabled, legacy, missing-target states).
